plugins.name: grumpy-senior-engineer-workflow
plugins.description: A workflow toolkit for driving AI coding agents safely. Ships /grumpy-context: a minimal, deduplicated, per-subproject context store (<=500 chars per entry) kept in .contexts/, auto-loaded at session start. Also ships /grumpy-adr: architecture decision records in docs/adr/, with a draft-approve-number-audit lifecycle so agents stop re-litigating settled decisions. Also ships /grumpy-plan: a required ten-section checklist for any Plan-mode deliverable, gated by a hook on ExitPlanMode so a plan missing sections gets bounced back before you see it. Also ships /grumpy-implement: builds an approved plan (from docs/plans/) under the same guardrails it was designed with, pausing on real forks instead of resolving them silently.
